milestone: Complete & demonstrate Hadal Dynamics' first end-to-end underwater vehicle integration by building a standardized vehicle connector that ingests ROV telemetry & sensor data, normalizes into Hadal Dynamics data architecture and displays real-time within live-operations. The goal is to prove that Hadal Dynamics can connect to external underwater vehicle systems to establish a repeatable integration framework.
metrics: 1 end-to-end underwater vehicle integration, 1 standardized vehicle connector
